381: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ; ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
The slanderer shall never attain emancipation; such is the Will of the Lord and Master.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ; ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
The more the Saints are slandered, the more they dwell in peace. ॥3॥
ਸੰਤਾ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
The Saints have Your support, O Lord and Master; You are the Saints' help and support.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੀਏ ਰੁੜਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੧॥
Says Nanak, the Saints are saved by the Lord, and the slanderers are swept away. ॥4॥2॥41॥
ਬਾਹਰੁ ਧੋਇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ; ਦੁਇ ਠਉਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਖੋਏ ॥
He washes himself outwardly, but within, his mind is filthy; thus he loses his place in both worlds.
ਈਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ; ਆਗੈ ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਰੋਏ ॥੧॥
Here, he is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and attachment; hereafter, he shall sigh and weep. ॥1॥
ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ; ਹੈ ਹੋਰਾ ॥
The way to meditate on the Lord of the Universe is different.
ਵਰਮੀ ਮਾਰੀ. ਸਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਰਈ; ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਸੁਨਈ ਡੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Beating the snake's hole, the snake is not killed; one who does not hear the Name is deaf to it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਵਾਈ; ਭਗਤੀ. ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
He has given up working for a livelihood, yet he does not know the value of devotional worship.
ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਉ ਤਰਕਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ; ਤਤੁ ਜੋਗੁ. ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
He argues over the Vedas and Shastras, but does not understand the essence of union with the Lord. ॥2॥
ਉਘਰਿ ਗਇਆ. ਜੈਸਾ ਖੋਟਾ ਢਬੂਆ; ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
He is exposed, like a counterfeit coin, when it comes before the assayer.
ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ; ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything; how can anything be hidden from Him? ॥3॥
ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਬੰਚਿ ਨਿੰਮੁਨੀਆਦਾ; ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਤਤਕਾਲੇ ॥
Through falsehood, fraud and deceit, his life, which has no foundation, crumbles away in an instant.
ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ. ਨਾਨਕਿ ਕਹਿਆ; ਅਪਨੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੨॥
Nanak has spoken the Truest of the true: look within your own heart, and see the Lord enshrined there. ॥4॥3॥42॥
ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ. ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਨਾਚੈ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Making the effort of praise, the mind becomes pure; this is the dance, shedding one's ego.
ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਲੇ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
He keeps the five passions under control, and the One Lord dwells in his mind. ॥1॥
ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ; ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Your humble servant dances and sings Your glorious praises.
ਰਬਾਬੁ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਤਾਲ ਘੁੰਘਰੂ; ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He plays the unstruck melody of the Word; this is his rebab, tambourine, cymbals and ankle bells. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ. ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਅਪਨਾ; ਪਾਛੈ. ਅਵਰ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ॥
First, he instructs his own mind, and then he inspires others.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਾਪੈ; ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
He chants the Lord's Name within his heart, and with his mouth he proclaims it to all. ॥2॥
ਕਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੈ; ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
With his hands, he washes the feet of the Holy, and applies the dust of the Saints to his body.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ; ਸਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
He surrenders his mind and body, placing them before the Guru, and obtains the true treasure. ॥3॥
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਪੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ਸਰਧਾ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Whoever listens and beholds this with faith is rid of the pain of birth and death.
ਐਸੀ ਨਿਰਤਿ. ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੪੩॥
Such a dance saves one from hell, O Nanak; the Gurmukh remains wakeful. ॥4॥4॥43॥
ਅਧਮ ਚੰਡਾਲੀ. ਭਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੀ; ਸੂਦੀ ਤੇ. ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
The lowly outcaste nature has become a Brahmin, and the low-caste has become exalted.
ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਸਖਨੀ; ਲਹਬਰ ਬੂਝੀ. ਖਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
The fire of desire, which could not be satisfied by all the treasures of the underworlds and the heavens, has been quenched. ॥1॥
ਘਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਲਾਈ. ਅਵਰ ਸਿਖਾਈ; ਮੂਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਡਰਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
The house-cat of discontent has been taught otherwise, and is now afraid when it sees the mouse of worldly things.
ਅਜ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ. ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੇਹਰਿ; ਕੂਕਰ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru has put the tiger of ego under the control of the sheep of humility, and has set the dogs of the senses to eat grass. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਾਝੁ ਥੂਨੀਆ. ਛਪਰਾ ਥਾਮੑਿਆ; ਨੀਘਰਿਆ. ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥
Without pillars, the roof of the mind has been supported, and the homeless mind has found a home.
ਬਿਨੁ ਜੜੀਏ. ਲੈ ਜੜਿਓ ਜੜਾਵਾ; ਥੇਵਾ. ਅਚਰਜੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Without the jeweller, the jewelled ornament has been fashioned, and the wonderful gem of the Name set into it. ॥2॥
ਦਾਦੀ ਦਾਦਿ. ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ; ਚੂਪੀ. ਨਿਰਨਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥
The complainer could never obtain justice, but now, keeping silent, I have obtained justice.
ਮਾਲਿ ਦੁਲੀਚੈ ਬੈਠੀ ਲੇ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ; ਨੈਨ ਦਿਖਾਲਨੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
The haughty nature that sat on cushions has died, and I no longer run about glaring at others. ॥3॥
382: ਸੋਈ ਅਜਾਣੁ. ਕਹੈ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾ; ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰੁ. ਨ ਛਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
One who says, "I know", is ignorant; one who truly knows does not remain hidden.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਿ, ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਆਇਆ; ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੪॥
Says Nanak, the Guru has given me the ambrosial nectar to drink; savouring and enjoying it, I blossom forth. ॥4॥5॥44॥
ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ. ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ਅਉਗਨ; ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿਆ ॥
He has cut away my bonds and forgotten my faults, and so He has affirmed His innate nature.
ਹੋਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ. ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤ ਨਿਆਈ; ਬਾਰਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Becoming merciful to me, like a mother or father, He has cherished me as His own child. ॥1॥
The Guru, the Lord of the World, protects the Sikhs of the Guru.
ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਮਹਾ ਭਵਜਲ ਤੇ; ਅਪਨੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Gazing upon them with His glance of grace, He pulls them out of the great, terrifying world-ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ. ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ; ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Remembering Him in meditation, we escape the messenger of death; here and hereafter, we obtain peace.
ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ; ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
With every breath and morsel of food, chant His Name with your tongue; let us sing His glorious praises each and every day. ॥2॥
ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ. ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
Through loving devotional worship, the supreme state is obtained, and in the company of the Holy, sorrows depart.
ਛਿਜੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ. ਕਿਛੁ ਭਉ, ਨ ਬਿਆਪੇ; ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗਾਠੇ ॥੩॥
The pure wealth of the Lord gathered by them does not wear away or depart, and no fear touches it. ॥3॥
ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ; ਇਤ ਉਤ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
At the very last moment, God is our help and support; here and hereafter, He is our Saviour.
ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੀਤ ਹੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੪੫॥
His Name is my wealth, the friend and well-wisher of my soul; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ॥4॥6॥45॥
ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ. ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ; ਹਉ. ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
When You are my Lord and Master, what is there to fear? Other than You, whom should I praise?
ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ. ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ; ਮੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
When You are with me, I have everything; without You, I have no other at all. ॥1॥
O Father, I have seen that the world is poison.
ਰਖਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ; ਮੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Protect me, O my Lord and Master; Your Name is my only support. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ. ਸਭਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ; ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ. ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
You know the whole condition of my mind; to whom else could I go to tell it?
ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਇਆ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Without the Name, the whole world has gone insane; obtaining the Name, one finds peace. ॥2॥
ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ. ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ; ਜਿ ਕਹਣਾ. ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
What should I say? To whom should I speak? Whatever I have to say, I say to God.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤੈ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੩॥
Everything that happens is Your doing; forever and ever, You are my hope. ॥3॥
ਜੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ. ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਇਤ ਉਤ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
If You bless me with greatness, then it is Your greatness; here and hereafter, I meditate on You.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ; ਮੈ. ਤਾਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੬॥
O God of Nanak, forever the Giver of peace, Your Name alone is my strength. ॥4॥7॥46॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਜਨਹਿ ਪੀਓ ॥
Your Name is ambrosial nectar, O Lord and Master; Your humble servant drinks in this supreme essence.
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਚੂਕੇ ਭੈ ਭਾਰੇ; ਦੁਰਤੁ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਓ ਭਰਮੁ ਬੀਓ ॥੧॥
The fearful load of sins of countless births has been removed, and doubt and duality have been dispelled. ॥1॥
I live by beholding the vision of Your Darshan.
ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਰੁ ਥੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Listening to Your words, O True Guru, my mind and body are cooled and soothed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ; ਏਹੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਓ ॥
By Your grace, I have joined the company of the Holy; You Yourself have done this.
ਦਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ; ਸਹਜੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਭਈ ਖੀਓ ॥੨॥
Holding tight to Your feet, God, the poison of Maya has been easily neutralised. ॥2॥
ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰਾ; ਏਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਲੀਓ ॥
Your Name, God, is the treasure of peace; I have received this everlasting Mantra.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ; ਤਾਪੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੈਰੁ ਗੀਓ ॥੩॥
Showing His mercy, the True Guru has given it to me, and my fever, pain and hatred have been annulled. ॥3॥
ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਪਾਈ; ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਓ ॥
Blessed is this human body I have obtained, through which God has united me with Himself.
ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ. ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੀਓ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੭॥
Blessed is this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, in which the Kirtan of the Lord's praises is sung in the company of the Holy; O Nanak, the Name is the support of the heart. ॥4॥8॥47॥
383: ਆਗੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੂਆ; ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Everything was already pre-ordained; what else can be known through study?
ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਬਖਸਿਆ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
The Supreme Lord God has forgiven His child for his mistakes and errors. ॥1॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ॥
My True Guru is always merciful; He has saved me, the meek one.
ਕਾਟਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ. ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He has cured me of my disease, and I have obtained the greatest peace; He has placed the Ambrosial Name of the Lord in my mouth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਪ ਮੇਰੇ. ਪਰਹਰਿਆ; ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ. ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ॥
He has washed away my countless sins; He has cut away my bonds, and I am liberated.
ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਘੋਰ ਤੇ; ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ॥੨॥
Taking me by the arm, the Guru has pulled me out of the horrible, deep, dark well. ॥2॥
ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ. ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ; ਰਾਖੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
I have become fearless, and all my fears have been erased; the Saviour Lord has saved me.
ਐਸੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ; ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Such is Your gift, O my God, that all my affairs have been resolved. ॥3॥
My mind has met with my Lord and Master, the treasure of virtue.
Seeking His sanctuary, Nanak has become blissful. ॥4॥9॥48॥
ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ. ਤਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੂ; ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
When I forget You, everyone becomes my enemy; when You come to mind, everyone serves me.
ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਊ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੂਝੈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
I know no other at all, O True, unseen, inscrutable Lord. ॥1॥
ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਲੋਗਨ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥
When He comes to mind, He is always merciful; what can poor people do to me?
ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ. ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ; ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Tell me, whom should I call bad or good, since all beings are Yours? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ. ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰਾ; ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ. ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ॥
You are my shelter, You are my support; giving me Your hand, You protect me.
ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ. ਤੇਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਤਿਸ ਕਉ. ਬਿਪੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਭਾਖੈ ॥੨॥
That humble being upon whom You bestow Your grace — no one speaks ill of him. ॥2॥
ਓਹੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਓਹਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
That is peace, and that is greatness, which is pleasing to the mind of the Dear Lord.
ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਦ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
You are all-knowing, You are forever compassionate; obtaining Your Name, I revel in its love. ॥3॥
ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ; ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
I offer my prayer to You: my body and soul are all Yours.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਕੋਈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ. ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੯॥
Says Nanak, this is all Your greatness; no one would even know my name. ॥4॥10॥49॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Show Your mercy, O God, Inner-knower of hearts, that in the company of the Holy I may find You, Lord.
ਖੋਲਿ ਕਿਵਾਰ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਪੁਨਰਪਿ. ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
He opens the doors and reveals the vision of His Darshan, and then one is not born again. ॥1॥
ਮਿਲਉ ਪਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਉ ਰੇ ॥
Meeting my Beloved Lord and Master, all my pains are taken away.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਨੑਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am saved in the company of those who have worshipped the Supreme Lord God in their hearts. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ. ਪਾਵਕ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਏ; ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
This world is a great wilderness, an ocean of fire, in which people dwell in pleasure and pain.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
Meeting the True Guru, the mind becomes pure, chanting the Ambrosial Name of the Lord with the tongue. ॥2॥
ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਕੋਮਲ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥
He claims his body and wealth as all his own, and is bound by subtle bonds.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥੩॥
By the Guru's grace, the humble are liberated, worshipping the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ॥3॥
ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
God, the Saviour, has saved those who are pleasing to His Will.
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਦਾਤੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੫੦॥
Soul and body are all Yours, O Great Giver; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice. ॥4॥11॥50॥
ਮੋਹ ਮਲਨ. ਨੀਦ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕੀ; ਕਉਨੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਭਇਓ ਰੀ ॥
You have escaped from the sleep of attachment that defiles the mind; what blessing has been granted to you?
ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ. ਤੁਧੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ; ਤੇਰਾ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The great enticer, Maya, does not affect you; where has your laziness gone? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
384: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਾਖਰੋ; ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਉਨ. ਛੁਟਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
Sexual desire, anger and ego are so very difficult; by what means have you escaped them?
ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਅਸੁਰ, ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨੀਆ; ਸਗਲੋ ਭਵਨੁ ਲੁਟਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
Good people, gods and demons, the beings of the three qualities — the whole world has been plundered by them. ॥1॥
ਦਾਵਾ ਅਗਨਿ. ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਜਾਲੇ; ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿਆ ਬੂਟੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
When the forest fire burns down so much of the grass, how rare is the plant that remains green.
ਐਸੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ. ਵਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ. ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
I cannot describe the strength of such a one; his glory cannot be told. ॥2॥
ਕਾਜਰ ਕੋਠ ਮਹਿ, ਭਈ ਨ ਕਾਰੀ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਰਨੁ. ਬਨਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
In the storeroom of lamp-black, I did not turn black; my colour remained spotless.
ਮਹਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ, ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਿਓ; ਅਚਰਜ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
The Great Mantra of the Guru has come to dwell within my heart, and I have heard the wondrous Name. ॥3॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਦਰਿ ਅਵਲੋਕਨ; ਅਪੁਨੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
Showing His mercy, God has looked upon me with His glance of grace, and has attached me to His feet.
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੫੧॥
Through loving devotional worship, O Nanak, I have found peace; I am absorbed in the company of the Holy. ॥4॥12॥51॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
That red robe looks so beautiful on your body.
You are pleasing to your Husband Lord, and so you have enticed my mind. ॥1॥
O sister, how did this red glow come to you?
ਕਵਨ ਰੰਗਿ; ਤੂੰ ਭਈ ਗੁਲਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By whose love have you become so deeply coloured? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
You are so beautiful; you are the happy soul-bride.
ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਲਨੁ; ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
Your Beloved is in your home, and good fortune is in your home. ॥2॥
You are pure and chaste; you are most distinguished.
ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਨੀ; ਤੁਹੀ ਸੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ॥੩॥
You are pleasing to your Beloved, and you have sublime understanding. ॥3॥
"I am pleasing to my Beloved, and so I am imbued with the deep red colour of His love."
Says Nanak, "He has blessed me with His glance of grace." ॥4॥
ਸੁਨਿ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ; ਇਹ ਹਮਰੀ ਘਾਲ ॥
Listen, O companion: this is my only effort,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ, ਸਵਾਰਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੫੨॥
that God Himself, the Embellisher, has adorned me. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥1॥52॥
I suffered great pain when I was far from Him;
but now, through the Guru's teaching, I have obtained His presence. ॥1॥
My complaints are over, O my companions and friends.
ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ; ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My doubt is gone; the Guru has united me with my Husband Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Drawing me near, He has placed me on the bed of my Beloved.
I have been released from dependence on others. ॥2॥
In the mansion of my heart, the light of the Word shines.
My Husband Lord is joyful and playful. ॥3॥
ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ; ਮੈ. ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
My destiny on my forehead has awakened; my Husband Lord has come home.
Servant Nanak has obtained the everlasting married life. ॥4॥2॥53॥
My mind is attached to the True Name.
My dealings with other people are only superficial. ॥1॥
Outwardly, I am on good terms with all;
ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹਉ; ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਉਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but I remain detached, like the lotus upon the water. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੁਖ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ; ਸਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
By word of mouth, I talk with everyone,
but I keep God clasped to my heart. ॥2॥
ਸਗਲ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
but my mind is the dust of the feet of all. ॥3॥
Servant Nanak has found the perfect Guru;
385: inwardly and outwardly, He has shown him the One Lord. ॥4॥3॥54॥
The mortal revels in pleasures, while he has the strength of youth;
but without the Name, he mingles with dust. ॥1॥
He may wear ear-rings and fine clothes,
and have a comfortable bed, and his mind may be so proud. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He may have elephants to ride, and golden umbrellas over his head;
ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ; ਲੇ ਧਰਨਿ ਗਡਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
but without devotional worship of the Lord, he is buried beneath the earth. ॥2॥
He may enjoy many women of exquisite beauty;
ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸਭਿ ਸੁਆਦ ਫਿਕਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
but without the sublime essence of the Lord, all tastes are tasteless. ॥3॥
Deluded by Maya, the mortal is led into sin and corruption.
Nanak seeks the sanctuary of God, the all-powerful, compassionate Lord. ॥4॥4॥55॥
There is a garden in which so many plants have grown.
In those watered with the Ambrosial Name, the fruit of a lofty life ripens. ॥1॥
O wise one, reflect in such a way
that you may attain the state of desirelessness.
ਆਸਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਿਖੂਆ ਕੇ ਕੁੰਟਾ; ਬੀਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
All around you are springs of poison, but within you is the ambrosial nectar, O brother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
There is only one gardener who waters it all;
ਖਬਰਿ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ; ਪਾਤ ਪਤ ਡਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
He takes care of every leaf and branch. ॥2॥
He brings all sorts of plants and sets them in place;
they all blossom, and none is without fruit. ॥3॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
One who receives the ambrosial fruit of the Name from the Guru —
O Nanak, such a servant crosses over the ocean of Maya. ॥4॥5॥56॥
Through Your Name, I have the pleasures of royalty.
I attain Yoga, singing the Kirtan of Your praises. ॥1॥
All comforts are obtained in Your shelter.
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਪਰਦੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਖੋਲੑੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The True Guru has drawn back the veils of doubt. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Understanding Your Command, I revel in pleasure and joy.
Serving the True Guru, I obtain the supreme state of desirelessness. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ; ਸੋ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
One who knows You is accepted, whether householder or renunciate.
Imbued with the Name, he is free of desire. ॥3॥
One who has obtained the treasure of the Name —
ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਪੂਰ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੭॥
prays Nanak, his treasure-house is full. ॥4॥6॥57॥
ਤੀਰਥਿ ਜਾਉ ਤ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
Going to the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, I see people acting in ego.
If I ask the Pandits, I find them imbued with Maya. ॥1॥
Show me that place, O friend,
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
where the Kirtan of the Lord's praises is forever sung. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Shastras and Vedas speak of sin and virtue;
they say that mortals are reincarnated into hell and heaven, over and over again. ॥2॥
In the householder's life there is anxiety, and in the renunciate's life there is ego.
Performing religious rituals, the soul is entangled. ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
By God's grace, the mind is brought under control;
O Nanak, the Gurmukh crosses over the ocean of Maya. ॥4॥
In the company of the Holy, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's praises.
ਇਹੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ; ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭॥੫੮॥
This place is found through the Guru. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥7॥58॥
ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਖ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਖਾ ॥
Within my home there is peace, and outside there is peace as well.
Remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains are erased. ॥1॥
ਸਗਲ ਸੂਖ; ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਂਵੈਂ ॥
There is total peace, when You come into my mind, Lord.
386: ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ; ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He alone chants the Name, who is pleasing to You. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ; ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
My body and mind are cooled and soothed, chanting Your Name.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ; ਢਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the house of pain is demolished. ॥2॥
One who understands His Command is accepted;
the True Word is his insignia. ॥3॥
The perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me.
ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੫੯॥
Prays Nanak, my mind has found peace. ॥4॥8॥59॥
Wherever You send me, there I go.
ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਁ ॥੧॥
Whatever You give me, that brings me peace. ॥1॥
I am forever Your servant, O Lord of the Universe, Master of the world.
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈਁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By Your grace, I am satisfied and fulfilled. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Whatever You give me, I wear and eat.
By Your grace, God, my life passes in peace. ॥2॥
Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on You.
I recognise no one else as equal to You. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, may I ever meditate on You in this way,
and be emancipated, grasping the feet of the Saints. ॥4॥9॥60॥
While standing up, sitting down and even while asleep, meditate on the Lord.
Walking on the path, sing the Praises of the Lord. ॥1॥
With your ears, listen to the ambrosial sermon,
ਜਾਸੁ ਸੁਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦਾ; ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਮਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
hearing which the mind is filled with bliss, and all the pains and diseases of the mind depart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
At work, on the road and at the river crossing, chant the Name.
By the Guru's grace, drink in the ambrosial essence of the Lord. ॥2॥
Day and night, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's praises.
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ; ਜਮ ਕੀ ਵਾਟ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
That humble being does not have to walk on the path of death. ॥3॥
One who does not forget You, twenty-four hours a day, Lord —
ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੧॥
O Nanak, others are emancipated by falling at his feet. ॥4॥10॥61॥
Remembering Him in meditation, one dwells in peace;
one is blessed with well-being, and pain is dispelled. ॥1॥
ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
Celebrate in bliss, and sing the glorious praises of God.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Forever and ever, win the favour of your True Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Practise the True Word of the True Guru.
ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
Remaining steady in your own home, you shall find your God. ॥2॥
ਪਰ ਕਾ ਬੁਰਾ; ਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਚੀਤ ॥
Do not harbour ill will for others in your mind,
ਤੁਮ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ; ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
and you shall not be troubled, O brother, O friend. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ; ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥
The Guru has given the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, as the only charm and Mantra.
O Nanak, night and day, he recognises this peace within. ॥4॥11॥62॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕਉ; ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
That lowly being whom no one knows —
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਉਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
chanting the Name, he is honoured in the four directions. ॥1॥
I beg for the vision of Your Darshan; please give it to me, Beloved.
ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ. ਨ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Who has not been saved by serving You? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ; ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
That person whom no one would approach —
ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਉਆ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਈ ॥੨॥
the whole world comes to wash the dirt from his feet. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ; ਕਾਹੂ. ਨ ਆਵਤ ਕਾਮ ॥
That mortal who is of no use to anyone —
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
by the grace of the Saints, he is remembered everywhere. ॥3॥
In the company of the Holy, the sleeping mind awakens.
Then, O Nanak, God seems sweet. ॥4॥12॥63॥
With my eyes, I behold the One and Only Lord everywhere.
Forever and ever, I contemplate the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
387: I sing the glorious praises of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ. ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the grace of the Saint, in the company of the Holy, I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਈ ॥
Everything is strung on His thread;
He is contained in each and every heart. ॥2॥
He creates and destroys in an instant.
He Himself remains unattached, beyond the three qualities. ॥3॥
He is the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Inner-knower of hearts.
Nanak's Lord and Master is forever in bliss. ॥4॥13॥64॥
My wandering through millions of births has ended.
I have won this human body, so difficult to obtain, and have not lost it. ॥1॥
My sins have been erased, and my pain and suffering are gone.
ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ; ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have been purified by the dust of the feet of the Saints. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Saints of God have the power to save us;
they meet only that one who has such pre-ordained destiny. ॥2॥
My mind is in bliss; the Guru has given me the Mantra.
My thirst has been quenched, and my mind has become steady. ॥3॥
The treasure of the Name is, for me, the nine treasures and the spiritual powers.
O Nanak, I have obtained this understanding from the Guru. ॥4॥14॥65॥
My thirst, born of the darkness of ignorance, has been quenched.
Serving the Holy Guru, countless sins have been cut away. ॥1॥
There is peace, poise and great bliss.
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ, ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Serving the Guru, the mind becomes pure; one hears the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The foolish stubbornness of the mind is gone,
and God's Will has become sweet to me. ॥2॥
Those who have grasped the feet of the perfect Guru —
the sins of millions of births are washed away. ॥3॥
The jewel of this human life has become fruitful.
Says Nanak, God has shown mercy to me. ॥4॥15॥66॥
Forever and ever, keep your True Guru enshrined within.
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ; ਕੇਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਝਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Dust the feet of the Guru with your hair. ॥1॥
Wake up, O my mind, you who are able to awaken!
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ ਕਾਮਾ; ਝੂਠਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Lord, nothing else shall be of use to you; false is emotional attachment, and useless is the expanse of the world. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ; ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Embrace love for the Bani of the Guru's Word.
When the Guru shows mercy, pain is dispelled. ॥2॥
Without the Guru, there is no other place of rest.
The Guru is the Giver; the Guru gives the Name. ॥3॥
The Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord Himself.
Twenty-four hours a day, O Nanak, meditate on the Guru. ॥4॥16॥67॥
He Himself is the tree, and the branches spreading out.
He Himself preserves His own crop. ॥1॥
Wherever I look, I see that One Lord alone.
ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਆਪੇ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Deep within each and every heart, He Himself is contained. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He Himself is the sun, and the rays emanating from it.
He is hidden, and He is manifest. ॥2॥
He is said to be with qualities and without qualities; He Himself establishes these names.
Both converge in His one place. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt and fear;
with my eyes, I behold the Lord, the embodiment of bliss, everywhere. ॥4॥17॥68॥
I know nothing of arguments or cleverness.
388: Day and night, I chant Your Name. ॥1॥
I am worthless; I have no virtue at all.
God is the Creator, the Cause of causes. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I am foolish, stupid, ignorant and thoughtless;
ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਆਸ; ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
I hold in my mind the hope of Your Name. ॥2॥
ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ; ਕਰਮ ਨ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
I have not practised chanting, penance, self-discipline or good deeds;
I worship God's Name within my mind. ॥3॥
ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ; ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
I know nothing, and my intellect is inadequate.
Prays Nanak, God, I seek Your protection. ॥4॥18॥69॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਖਰ ਦੁਇ; ਇਹ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
These two words, "Har, Har", make up my rosary.
Chanting and reciting this rosary, God becomes merciful even to the meek. ॥1॥
I offer my prayer to my True Guru:
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਹੁ, ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
shower Your mercy upon me, keep me in Your sanctuary, and give me the rosary of the Lord, Har, Har. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who enshrines the rosary of the Lord's Name within the heart
is rid of the pain of birth and death. ॥2॥
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਮਾਲੈ; ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
One who contemplates the Lord within the heart, and chants the Lord's Name with the mouth,
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਇਤ ਉਤ; ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੩॥
Says Nanak, one who is imbued with the Name —
the rosary of the Lord's Name goes along with him to the world beyond. ॥4॥19॥70॥
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
One who belongs to Him, to whom all things belong —
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ; ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
no stain of Maya clings to that humble being. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
The Lord's servant is forever liberated.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ. ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਜਨ ਕੈ; ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whatever He does is pleasing to His servant; the way of life of His slave is utterly pure. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who renounces everything and enters the Lord's sanctuary —
how can Maya cling to him? ॥2॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
One whose mind holds the treasure of the Name
is not troubled by anxiety, even in a dream. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, I have found the perfect Guru;
my doubt and attachment have been completely erased. ॥4॥20॥71॥
When my God is totally pleased with me,
ਤਾਂ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ; ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
then tell me, how can pain or doubt draw near me? ॥1॥
Continually listening to Your glory, I live.
ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਉ; ਲੇਹੁ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am worthless; save me, O Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
My pain has been erased, and my anxiety forgotten.
I have obtained my reward, chanting the Mantra of the True Guru. ॥2॥
He is True, and True is His glory.
Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, keep Him clasped to your heart. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, what religious rituals are left for that one,
within whose mind the Lord's Name abides? ॥4॥21॥72॥
People are ruined by sexual desire, anger and ego.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥
Remembering the Lord in meditation, the Lord's humble servants are saved. ॥1॥
The mortals are asleep, intoxicated with the wine of Maya.
ਜਾਗਤ ਭਗਤ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The devotees remain awake, imbued with the Lord's meditation. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In emotional attachment and doubt, the mortals wander through countless births.
The devotees remain steady, meditating on the Lord's feet. ॥2॥
Bound by household and possessions, the mortals are lost in a deep, dark well.
The Saints are liberated, knowing the Lord to be near at hand. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, one who seeks God's sanctuary
obtains peace in this world, and emancipation in the next. ॥4॥22॥73॥
389: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਰੰਗੁ; ਹਮ ਮੀਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
You are the water, and I am Your fish.
ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਹਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
You are my Lord and Master; I wait at Your door. ॥1॥
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਤਾ; ਹਉ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
You are my Creator, and I am Your servant.
ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have taken Your sanctuary, O God, most profound and virtuous. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
You are my life, You are my support.
Beholding You, the lotus of my heart blossoms forth. ॥2॥
ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ; ਤੂ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
You are my salvation and honour; whatever You do, I accept.
You are all-powerful; You are my strength. ॥3॥
Night and day, I chant Your Name, O treasure of virtue.
This is Nanak's prayer to God. ॥4॥23॥74॥
The one who weeps for the dead acts in falsehood.
The stranger mourns while laughing and laughing. ॥1॥
ਕੋ ਮੂਆ; ਕਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਨੁ ॥
Someone has died, and in someone's house there is singing.
ਕੋ ਰੋਵੈ; ਕੋ ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਪਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One weeps and wails, and another laughs and laughs. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
the mortal does not reach the goal of his hopes, and repents in the end. ॥2॥
The world is in the grip of the three qualities.
The mortal is reincarnated, over and over again, into hell and heaven. ॥3॥
Says Nanak, one whom the Lord attaches to the Name —
his life is fruitful and accepted. ॥4॥24॥75॥
ਸੋਇ ਰਹੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਬਰਿ. ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
She remains asleep, and does not heed the teachings of God.
And when the day dawns, she regrets and repents. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਜਿ; ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਧਰਉ ਰੀ ॥
Loving my Beloved, I abide in intuitive poise, with bliss in my mind, O companion.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕੀ ਲਾਲਸਾ; ਤਾ ਤੇ. ਆਲਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I long to meet God; so why should I be lazy? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He poured the ambrosial nectar into her hands,
but it slipped through her fingers and fell to the ground. ॥2॥
She is weighed down with the flavours of pleasure, attachment and ego;
this is not the fault of God the Creator. ॥3॥
In the company of the Holy, the darkness of doubt is dispelled.
O Nanak, the Creator Lord unites her with Himself. ॥4॥25॥76॥
One who longs for Your lotus feet, O Beloved —
the wretched messengers of death flee from him. ॥1॥
You come into the mind by Your mercy.
ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ; ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗ ਖਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Remembering the Name in meditation, all diseases are destroyed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Death gives so much pain to others,
ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ; ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਉ ॥੨॥
but it cannot even come near Your humble servant. ॥2॥
ਦਰਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
One whose mind thirsts for the vision of Your Darshan
dwells in peaceful poise and bliss, detached from Maya. ॥3॥
and give only Your Name to dwell within his heart. ॥4॥26॥77॥
The mind is satisfied, and its entanglements are erased,
By the grace of the Saint, things have turned out well.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨੁ; ਸੋ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I have met the fearless Lord and Master, in whose home everything is perfect and plentiful. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The merciful Holy Guru has implanted the Name within me,
and my terrible hunger has departed. ॥2॥
My Lord and Master has bestowed His gift;
my burning has been quenched, and my mind has become tranquil. ॥3॥
ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਭਾਲ; ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
My search has ended, and my mind is absorbed in intuitive poise;
390: Nanak has found the treasure of the Name. ॥4॥27॥78॥
ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Those whose love is firmly bound to the Lord and Master
remain satisfied, with the perfect food of the Name. ॥1॥
ਕਛੂ ਨ ਥੋਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ॥
ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ; ਦੇਵਨ ਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
They have plenty to eat, spend, enjoy and give. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who has the inaccessible Lord of the Universe as his Master —
tell me, how can any mere mortal prevail against him? ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਈ ॥
One whose service brings the eighteen spiritual powers —
ਪਲਕ ਦਿਸਟਿ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
by whose glance of grace all is obtained — grasp His feet forever. ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ; ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Those upon whom You bestow Your mercy, O my Lord and Master —
When I meditate on my True Guru,
ਤਬ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ; ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
my mind is filled with supreme peace. ॥1॥
The accounting is erased, and doubt is dispelled;
ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ; ਭਏ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
imbued with the Name, the Lord's humble servants become fortunate. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Since I have enshrined my Lord and Master in my consciousness,
my fear has been dispelled, O my friend. ॥2॥
ਜਉ ਮੈ; ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Since I took Your protection, O God,
Beholding the wonders of Your play, my mind has become encouraged.
Slave Nanak relies on You alone. ॥4॥29॥80॥
Night and day, the mouse of death gnaws away at the rope of life.
Falling into the well, the mortal eats the sweets of Maya. ॥1॥
Thinking and plotting, the night of life passes away.
ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਚਿਤਵਤ; ਕਬਹੂ. ਨ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He thinks of the many pleasures of Maya, but he never remembers the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ; ਨਿਹਚਲ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥
Believing the shade of the tree to be permanent, he builds his house beneath it.
ਕਾਲ ਕੈ ਫਾਂਸਿ; ਸਕਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੨॥
But the noose of death is around his neck, and Maya has aimed her arrow. ॥2॥
The sandy shore is being washed away by the waves,
ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ; ਮੂੜਿ. ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
but the fool still believes that place to be permanent. ॥3॥
One who, in the company of the Holy, chants the Name of the Sovereign Lord —
O Nanak, he lives by singing the glorious praises of the Lord. ॥4॥30॥81॥
ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੂ ਕਰਤੀ ਕੇਲ ॥
O body, in the company of the soul you play;
ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲ ॥
with it, you are united with all.
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੁਮ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
With it, everyone longs for you,
ਓਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ; ਕੋਊ. ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
but without it, no one even looks at you. ॥1॥
Where has that detached soul now gone?
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਤੁਹੀ ਦੁਹੇਰੀ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without it, you are miserable. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੂ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਹਰਿ ॥
With it, you are the mistress of your household;
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੂ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਾਹਰਿ ॥
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੂ ਰਖੀ ਪਪੋਲਿ ॥
With it, you are cared for and pampered;
without it, you are cast aside to roll in the dust. ॥2॥
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
With it, you have honour and respect;
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੁਮ ਸਾਕੁ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
with it, the whole world is your relative.
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
With it, you are provided for in every way;
ਓਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ; ਤੂੰ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੩॥
without it, you have become dust. ॥3॥
That detached soul neither dies nor is born.
Bound by the Lord's Command, it does its work.
O Nanak, having fashioned the body, the Lord unites and separates them.
He alone knows His own creative power. ॥4॥31॥82॥
